name: The Earthen Ring
declaringWar: The elements are out of balance, and you are the cause. The Earthen Ring will set it right.
attacked: Fire, earth, wind and water rise against you!
defeated: The elements fall silent... for now.
introduction: The Earthen Ring greets you. We are the shamans who keep the elements in balance.

name: Knights of the Ebon Blade
declaringWar: Death knights do not forgive. The Ebon Blade rides against you.
attacked: You would cross runeblades with the Ebon Blade? So be it.
defeated: Even death knights can die twice.
introduction: We are the Knights of the Ebon Blade, free of the Lich King's will. State your purpose.

name: Explorers' League
declaringWar: Ye've wrecked yer last dig site. The League's coming for ye!
attacked: Hands off the artifacts!
defeated: The digs are buried... we'll be back.
introduction: Welcome to the Explorers' League! Mind the rope and don't touch anything old.

name: Thorium Brotherhood
declaringWar: The Brotherhood is done with ye. Our forges now make weapons for yer enemies.
attacked: Strike the Brotherhood and ye strike the hottest forges in Azeroth!
defeated: Thorium Point's fires go out.
introduction: The Thorium Brotherhood welcomes ye. We're the finest smiths outside Blackrock, and we left them for good reason.

name: Dalaran
declaringWar: The Kirin Tor have judged you a threat. The Violet Citadel goes to war.
attacked: You dare raise a hand against Dalaran? The archmagi will remember this.
defeated: Dalaran has fallen before... and it always rises again.
introduction: Greetings from the Kirin Tor. Dalaran's doors are open to all who seek knowledge.

name: Theramore
declaringWar: Jaina's patience has run out. Theramore's guard marches against you.
attacked: Theramore was built for peace, but it will defend itself.
defeated: Theramore's towers burn... again.
introduction: Welcome to Theramore, where Alliance and Horde may yet find peace.

name: Stromgarde
declaringWar: By the blood of Thoradin, Stromgarde will see you broken!
attacked: Stromgarde has held these highlands for a thousand years. We will not yield.
defeated: Arathor's last kingdom falls silent.
introduction: Stromgarde greets you. We are the heirs of Arathor, the first kingdom of men.

name: Gadgetzan
declaringWar: Bad for business, friend. Real bad. The Water Barons are coming for you.
attacked: Hey! Attacking a neutral town? There'll be a bill for this.
defeated: The bank's closed. Permanently.
introduction: Welcome to Gadgetzan! Everything's for sale, and the bruisers keep the peace.

name: Booty Bay
declaringWar: The Blackwater Raiders are hoisting the black flag. Run while you can!
attacked: You'll be swimming with the sharks for this, landlubber!
defeated: The bay is yours. Watch out for the sharks.
introduction: Ahoy! Welcome to Booty Bay. Mind your purse and your back.

name: Ratchet
declaringWar: Ratchet's pulling its contracts. Expect the bruisers.
attacked: You hit our docks? You're paying for the repairs!
defeated: Ratchet's docks go quiet.
introduction: Ratchet welcomes you! Best port on the Barrens coast, and the only one.

name: Everlook
declaringWar: Everlook is closing its gates to you, and opening its armories.
attacked: Out here the cold kills fools. So do we.
defeated: The snows of Winterspring cover Everlook.
introduction: Everlook greets you. Warm drinks, fair prices, and the only fire for miles.

name: Steamwheedle Port
declaringWar: The Cartel has voted. You're a liability.
attacked: An attack on Steamwheedle Port is an attack on the whole Cartel!
defeated: The Cartel cuts its losses.
introduction: Steamwheedle Port, open for business! Neutral ground, as long as you pay.

name: Light's Hope Chapel
declaringWar: The Light will judge you. The Argent Dawn rides.
attacked: We stood against the Scourge. We will stand against you.
defeated: Even now, the Light endures.
introduction: Be welcome at Light's Hope Chapel, last bastion against the Scourge.

name: Cenarion Hold
declaringWar: The Cenarion Circle will defend the balance of nature against you.
attacked: You bring blood to sacred ground. The druids will answer.
defeated: The Hold falls, but the Circle endures.
introduction: Cenarion Hold greets you. We watch the gates of Ahn'Qiraj so that others may sleep.

name: Argent Vanguard
declaringWar: The Argent Crusade marches against you!
attacked: We came north to fight the Lich King, not you. But we will.
defeated: The Vanguard's banners fall in the snow.
introduction: The Argent Vanguard stands at the gates of Icecrown. Will you join the crusade?

name: Feathermoon Stronghold
declaringWar: The Sentinels of Feathermoon nock their arrows. You are their target.
attacked: Elune guide our arrows against you.
defeated: Feathermoon falls under the shadow of the moon.
introduction: Ishnu-alah. Feathermoon Stronghold watches over the wilds of Feralas.

name: Timbermaw Hold
declaringWar: The Timbermaw have judged you an enemy of the forest. The furbolgs go to war.
attacked: You attack the Timbermaw? The forest remembers.
defeated: Timbermaw Hold... the tunnels fall silent.
introduction: The Timbermaw greet you, friend. Few outsiders are welcome in our hold.

name: Kamagua
declaringWar: The tuskarr of Kamagua take up their harpoons against you.
attacked: You strike at fishermen? Kamagua will fight.
defeated: Kamagua's nets lie empty. We are beaten.
introduction: Welcome to Kamagua, traveler. Sit, eat, and tell us news of the world.

name: Maraudine
declaringWar: The Maraudine ride to war! Your bones will bleach in Desolace.
attacked: You dare attack the sons of Theradras?
defeated: The Maraudine are scattered to the winds.
introduction: The Maraudine centaurs tolerate your presence. For now.

name: Jasperlode Mine
declaringWar: You no take candle! Kobolds fight now!
attacked: Why you attack? Kobolds angry!
defeated: Mine is lost... no more candle...
introduction: You no take candle. Kobolds trade ore and shinies. Maybe.

name: Razorfen Kraul
declaringWar: The quilboar of Razorfen charge from their thorns!
attacked: You come into the Kraul? You will not leave.
defeated: The thorns of Razorfen wither...
introduction: The Razorfen quilboar grunt a wary greeting from behind their thorn walls.

name: The Consortium
declaringWar: The Consortium has concluded that you are a bad investment. Hostilities commence.
attacked: Violence is bad for business. You will be billed for this.
defeated: The Consortium's contracts in this region are... terminated.
introduction: Greetings, friend. The Consortium trades in rare goods from beyond this world. Interested?

name: Mogu'shan
declaringWar: The mogu remember when they ruled. They will rule again, over your corpse.
attacked: You strike at the heirs of the Thunder King?
defeated: The stone guardians crumble. Mogu'shan falls.
introduction: The mogu of Mogu'shan regard you coldly. Their ancient lore may be yours, for a price.

name: Ahn'Qiraj
declaringWar: The hive stirs. The silithid swarm marches against you.
attacked: You disturb the hive of Ahn'Qiraj. You will be devoured.
defeated: The great hive is shattered... for now.
introduction: Beyond the Scarab Wall, the qiraji watch you with a thousand eyes.
